title: Fix Cli Performance Causing System Overload
description: Fix massive CLI performance problem. Multiple cli processes (search, analyze, hooks) spawn concurrently, each independently building full monorepo tree (BuildMonorepoTreeCached) which reads all files, parses sections, runs git commands, walks .repo. This causes load averages of 30-90+. Key fixes: 1) Add file-based lock to prevent concurrent tree builds 2) Make analyzeFile actually defined in extension.ts 3) Limit concurrent CLI spawns from vscode extension 4) Make hooks lightweight - skip tree building
summary: Fixed CLI performance causing system overload (load avg 30-90+). Two root causes: (1) Multiple concurrent CLI processes each independently building the full monorepo tree via BuildMonorepoTreeCached, causing CPU spikes of 100-200% per process. Added file-based flock in BuildMonorepoTreeCached so only one process builds at a time while others wait and use the cache. (2) VSCode extension spawning unlimited concurrent CLI subprocesses for analyze/search/section-list/definition-list. Added a concurrency semaphore (limit=2) via acquireCliSlot/releaseCliSlot gating all execAsync CLI calls.
